# `/service-integration`

Use when changing a cross-service contract — a Redis pub/sub payload, a BullMQ job (mind queue-name env split), or an HTTP shape between services. Covers publisher↔subscriber pairing, dual-write safety, idempotency, and contract versioning.

## Cách gọi

```text
/service-integration
```

## Tool được phép

`Read Grep Glob Bash`
